incident-bot: PAGER: [deploy-redwood-api] Canary error rate spike in eu-west-1 - service: inference-proxy - threshold exceeded (5m ERR% > 2%). Runbook: deploy-unwind.
Mia Chen: I'm on it, paging Samir (oncall).
Samir Patel: jumping in, looking at the canary group. what's the canary traffic percent?
Mia Chen: ~8% traffic routed to v2026.3, errors are 5xx and some model-timeout traces. latency from ~1.2s -> 2.8s.
Alex Rivera: I see a kernel-selection mismatch in the rollout config that could cause increased memory pressure. checking pod restarts.
Jordan Lee: oncall view shows pod restarts and liveness probes flapping, autoscaler didn't scale fast enough for initial surge.
Samir Patel: decision time — manual reversion to v2026.2 to stop customer impact. Mia, can you run the revert? follow the rollback checklist.
Mia Chen: starting manual rollback, preparing to switch traffic via rollout API.
Samir Patel: Use the revert command (internal):
```
curl -X POST https://console.internal.redwood/api/rollouts/revert \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}' \n  -d '{ "service": "inference-proxy", "target_version": "v2026.2", "traffic": 100 }'
```
Mia Chen: invoked revert at 1768888892, routing drain set to 30s, migrating canary pods back to v2026.2.
deploy-bot: Rollout revert started: job id rz-993, regions: eu-west-1, us-west-2, ap-south-1. Progress: eu-west-1 0->100 routing.
Rachel O'Neill: I'll watch customer-facing dashboards and SLOs. posting CPU/mem+error graphs to the thread.
Luis Gomez: I'll run smoke tests and validate the model version header on requests once traffic flips.
Luis Gomez: smoke check (quick):
```
for i in 1 2 3; do
  curl -s -I -H 'x-client: smoke' https://inference.api.eu-west-1/generate | grep x-model-version
done
```
Jordan Lee: seeing x-model-version: v2026.2 on responses now, error rate dropping in eu-west-1.
Rachel O'Neill: error rate down from 5.8% -> 0.4% in last 90s, latency back to baseline. No active customer tickets yet but CS flagged a few timeouts. tagging customers@eng.
Mia Chen: recommend keep traffic pinned to v2026.2 and mark v2026.3 as "hold" for investigation. creating a follow-up ticket.
Samir Patel: agreed. create INC ticket and assign to eng-ml for triage. Also note to collect kernel logs and any core dumps.
Mia Chen: created ticket INC-2026-1792 and assigned to eng-ml. rollback complete for eu-west-1; monitoring 10m stable window. ETA final confirmation in ~5m.
Alex Rivera: logs show the kernel-selection fallback path triggered in v2026.3; I will collect relevant logs and s3 them: s3://redwood-incidents/1768888888/ (uploading core and runtime logs).
Jordan Lee: memory spike correlated with a quantization codepath in the new runtime build.
Rachel O'Neill: Customer impact assessment: approximately 0.6% of global requests affected during the canary window (~1.2k reqs/min peak), no auth/data breaches, no SLO breach observed. Impact level: low-medium. Notifying account teams per comms playbook.
Luis Gomez: smoke tests pass end-to-end; inference outputs look nominal for sampled prompts.
deploy-bot: Rollout revert completed at 1768888901 - eu-west-1 done. All regions reporting healthy.
Samir Patel: On-call handoff scheduled: I'll hand to Jordan in 10m. Adding short checklist in INC-2026-1792: reproduce locally, isolate model delta, bisect commit range, evaluate kernel flags.
Rachel O'Neill: note for comms: only send customer-facing note if >1% active users impacted or SLO breach confirmed. this is below that threshold.
Mia Chen: :thumbsup: thanks team. closing live mitigation. Postmortem owner: Alex Rivera. Will reconvene after eng-ml triage.
Samir Patel: leaving thread, monitoring ticket.
Jordan Lee: standing by for postmortem, will take oncall in 10m.
incident-bot: Incident marked as mitigated at 1768888902.
